title: Telegram message
description: Starts the workflow when the connected Telegram bot receives a message with text, a caption, a photo or a document. A photo or document is kept as {{ trigger.input.file }} (fileId, filename, mimeType, size) so a later step such as OCR can read it; if it cannot be kept, file.skipped says why (too_large, not_stored or error). Needs a Telegram bot connection.

connectionId.title: Telegram bot connection
connectionId.description: Telegram bot connection (token from @BotFather). Only one active workflow can use a bot at a time.
